# 360Configurator — Full Product Context

360Configurator is a product initiative developed by 360design. It turns configurable physical products into browser-based spatial systems for customer exploration, sales qualification, engineering logic and downstream operational output.

## Platform capabilities

1. Bill of materials: valid configurations resolve into structured component and quantity data.
2. Dynamic pricing: dimensional and option changes update commercial totals in real time.
3. Extensive customization: dimensions, materials, components, finishes, accessories and behavior remain connected within one configuration state.
4. Real-time rendering: products are presented and manipulated interactively in the browser.
5. Dynamic day and night lighting: environmental lighting communicates material, shadow and integrated-light behavior.
6. Unified interface: visual choices, technical dependencies and commercial results share a coherent interaction system.

## Commercial deployment paths

360Configurator uses three commercial paths. Existing System is a subscription for a proven system whose established geometry and rules fit the product. Adapted System combines one-time product-specific adaptation with an ongoing platform subscription. Custom System combines implementation of a new configuration engine with an ongoing subscription. Public euro prices are not presented because geometry, data readiness, rules, BOM and pricing complexity, workflows, integrations, markets and launch requirements determine implementation scope. A technical review establishes product fit, the boundary between standard setup and engineering, and the recommended commercial path.

Canonical page: https://360configurator.com/pricing

## Pergola and outdoor architecture configurator

The pergola system supports parametric dimensions, louver-angle control, four independently configurable sides, screens, privacy walls, sliding glass, daylight and night environments, perimeter LEDs, selectable light color, integrated spotlights, automation, sensors, accessories and live project pricing.

Canonical page: https://360configurator.com/configurators/pergola
Live system: https://www.360configurator.com/pergola-configurator/

## Architectural roof and structure configurator

The roof system supports two-slope, four-slope, single-slope, L-shaped and dormer forms. Length, depth, wall height, roof pitch and eaves overhang are parametric. Material selection remains connected to geometry and measured output, including roof areas, ridges, valleys, gutters, component-level pricing, BOM and CSV export.

Canonical page: https://360configurator.com/configurators/roof
Live system: https://www.360configurator.com/roof-configurator/

## Window and architectural profile configurator

The profile system presents the Schüco Window System AW CT 65 B2-6 using its component relationships. It supports width and height changes, glazing thickness, compatible gasket and glazing-bead selection, side-hung and tilt opening behavior, opening angle, uniform or bicolor finishes, exploded assembly mode, technical debug colors and isolated profile-section inspection.

Canonical page: https://360configurator.com/configurators/window
Live system: https://www.360configurator.com/window-configurator/

## Industrial hall and warehouse configurator

The hall system supports parametric building length, span, eaves height and roof pitch; target portal-frame spacing; light, standard and heavy structural presets; industrial door dimensions; independent cladding and secondary-steel visibility; and exploded assembly inspection.

Canonical page: https://360configurator.com/configurators/hall
Live system: https://www.360configurator.com/hall-configurator/

## Solar roof and photovoltaic energy configurator

The solar system connects Romanian address context, date, season, real time of day and roof-front bearing with roof typology, dimensions, physical panel fit, household consumption profiles, LiFePO4 storage and production-versus-consumption analytics.

Canonical page: https://360configurator.com/configurators/solar
Live system: https://www.360configurator.com/solar-configurator/

## Fence and perimeter system configurator

The fence configurator resolves straight, L-shaped, U-shaped and closed perimeter layouts into measurable runs, equal bays, coordinated posts and configurable panels. It supports vertical and horizontal slats, privacy panels, welded mesh, multiple finishes, pedestrian and driveway gates, concrete or base-plate foundations, and geometry-driven BOM and pricing outputs.

Canonical page: https://360configurator.com/configurators/fence
Live system: https://www.360configurator.com/fence-configurator/

## Intended audiences

360Configurator is intended for manufacturers, product teams, sales organizations, architects, specifiers and customers working with products whose geometry, compatibility, pricing or production outputs are difficult to communicate through static pages or conventional option forms.

## Languages and canonical structure

English is served at https://360configurator.com/. Romanian is served under /ro and German under /de. Every translated page has a self-referencing canonical URL and reciprocal language alternates. The Romanian country domain redirects to https://360configurator.com/ro.
